purpose: Create and receive one original editable multi-piece performance whose angular bud, open bloom, fold and return use changing authored silhouettes.

geometry.independentMapping: Exact rational x=(svgX-200)/125; y=(150-svgY)/125, derived from the authored geometry before fitting.
geometry.framingLimit: These bounds describe the authored targets only; fitted and sampled intermediate pieces are checked separately.
geometry.preFitArtworkPreviews: Two direct polygon-coordinate draft previews were inspected during authoring. They did not invoke the maintained importer, fitter or movie exporter. The final authored source is pinned above.

course.fitCountSemantics: Selected fixed helper control flow and successful receipts; not independent dynamic tracing.

admission.sourceIdentity: Every staged file must match its frozen Git blob and SHA256 manifest before launch.
admission.capacityLimit: Host memory and process affinity are observations of this route, not a cgroup capacity guarantee.
admission.earlyFailureCustody: Output-directory setup and initial source hashing precede the receiver's main failure handler; the outer supervisor retains their launch/failure status.

criteria.qualityGateMeaning: Prechosen finite-grid creative-consumer limits, not exact fidelity or a universal quality criterion.
criteria.meanWeighting: Equal weight for all four authored moments, including the repeated bud at return.

observation.rule: Cell centers, half-open y and strict x ray crossing; Boolean union of independently projected physical pieces.
observation.score: XOR cell count / union cell count against the authored target; all polygon vertices must lie inside the observation window.
observation.retained: Four raw target masks, four raw prediction masks, all projected authored polygons, counts and scores.

criteria.decodedForeground: Pillow luminance <128, nonempty and no classified foreground at image edges for every one of 144 frames.
criteria.contactSheets: Four ordered 36-frame sheets from the same complete decode.

evidence.ordering: Render and decode the ordinary movie before applying authored-mask quality gates, retaining downstream artifacts even if the quality criterion fails.
retained: Frozen Git source and staged manifest
Original launch request and initial/final tool responses
Fresh admission, child status and terminal supervisor record
Original importer/exporter/decoder receipts, stdout/stderr and input copies
Independent authored masks and projected coordinates
Four full selected PNGs and four complete contact sheets
Separate geometry, source, data and visual reviews with their actual scope
evidence.visualReview: Actual retained contact sheets and selected frames will be inspected separately. Preserve the original result's pending-visual marker.

integration.afterReceiving: Retain the actual project.json unchanged; document observed silhouette error and motion limitations, add README discoverability and the necessary package entries, then build and inspect the final package once without replaying the creative course.
integration.unresolvedReadout: Original readout custody remains separate; no replay.

limits: This is ordinary creative use of the merged tools, not a new general solver or importer qualification.
Finite grid estimates and sampled framing do not establish continuous geometry or continuous-time safety.
A returned silhouette need not close every individual physical track; seamless looping is not asserted.
Intentional block-like outlines and square-cover motion are a stylized paper-flower study; botanical realism is not claimed.
Collision clearance, physical fabrication, browser pixel identity and performance benefits are not established.
